payload.text: Northbridge Labs was founded in 2019 by Elena Vasquez. The lab focuses on battery materials research. Its first facility opened in the Harbor District.
payload.title: Northbridge Labs founding note

payload.text: Project Aurora develops a solid-state electrolyte. The project lead is Marcus Chen. Aurora started in January 2021 with a team of six researchers.
payload.title: Project Aurora charter

payload.text: The lab operates a Raman spectrometer, asset tag EQ-7741. It is housed in Building B and maintained by the instrumentation team.
payload.title: Equipment register: spectrometer

payload.text: Dr. Priya Anand joined Northbridge Labs in March 2022 as a senior electrochemist. She reports to Marcus Chen on Project Aurora.
payload.title: Hiring memo: Dr. Priya Anand

payload.text: Project Borealis investigates sodium-ion cathodes. The project lead is Sofia Reyes. Borealis is funded through a grant from the Meridian Foundation.
payload.title: Project Borealis charter

payload.text: All electrolyte handling must occur in fume hood FH-2. Safety officer for 2022 is Tomas Eriksen. Incident reports go to the safety board within 48 hours.
payload.title: Safety policy v1

payload.text: Project Aurora achieved an ionic conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm in Q3 2022. The result was measured on sample batch AUR-118 using the EQ-7741 spectrometer.
payload.title: Q3 2022 milestone report

payload.text: Northbridge Labs signed a joint development agreement with Helios Cells in October 2022. The agreement covers pilot production of Aurora electrolytes.
payload.title: Partnership note: Helios Cells

payload.text: An argon glovebox, asset tag EQ-8102, was installed in Building A in November 2022. It is reserved for moisture-sensitive cell assembly.
payload.title: Equipment register: glovebox

payload.text: In 2022 Northbridge Labs grew to 24 staff. Project Aurora and Project Borealis are the two active programs. Elena Vasquez remains director.
payload.title: Annual review 2022 summary
